name: The Method of Cylindrical Shells (Vertical Axis of Revolution)
description: A method for calculating the volume of a solid of revolution by decomposing the region into representative vertical cylindrical shells and integrating with respect to x. For rotation around the y-axis, the volume is V = \int_a^b 2\pi x f(x) dx (or 2\pi x (f(x) - g(x)) between two curves), and for rotation around a vertical line x = k, the radius is adjusted to |x - k|.
